fact.en: Do not confuse Gupta scientific advancements with Vedic science; these were empirical and evidence-based.

fact.en: Avoid attributing the invention of Zero directly to Aryabhata; he popularized its use in positional notation, but the concept existed in the Bakshali manuscript period.
